# Contraption: 3x3 flush piston door. Contract: doc/redstone/circuits.md, "3x3 flush door".
# Generated by experiments/wip/door3x3/scripts/make_lib.py (door.py stage "safe"); the stages
# that led to it are worlds in that folder.
#
# Module (box 0 1 0 .. 16 8 11; the doorway is 7..9 4..6 2, seen from the south; floor top y 3):
#   @D00..@D22  the nine door cells: smooth stone while closed, air while open
#   @IN  8 2 11 input block: power it to open (the test lever @L on top, buttons @SB @OB beside)
# Sides and top: sticky pistons in the wall plane (x 5 facing east, x 11 facing west, 8 8 2 facing
# down) pull their blocks into the wall; wire staircases in the wall plane power them.
# Center column: C (center) and M (bottom middle) rest in the floor (8 3 2, 9 3 2) when open.
# Below C: sticky piston B (8 2 2) on sticky piston A (8 1 2); W (10 3 2) pushes M west.
#   close: B spits C up one, W pushes M under it, B pushes both up and holds them;
#   open: B pulls M down, W pulls it aside, A lifts B, B pulls C down one, A lowers B, B pulls
#   C into the floor.
# Controller (behind, z 3..11): the input torch feeds the lockout repeater @X, which feeds a
# wire trunk (z 7) with short repeater branches. @X is locked after each change of its output:
# by @OFFL while an open runs (26 ticks), by @ONL while a close runs (10 ticks); a request in
# between waits and is read when the lock ends, so no input timing can break the door.
# The spit is an observer behind B watching a wire spur. B's hold is the floor block 7 3 2
# (quasi-connectivity: B extends exactly when M lands under C). W's driver is locked by a
# delayed copy of the trunk, so W stays out until B has pulled M down. A's pulse is a
# subtracting comparator (west of A). An observer in front watches A: its pulses reach the
# floor block 7 3 2, which powers B raised (pull C down one) and, by quasi-connectivity, B at
# home when A sets it down (the final pull).
#   redsim-cli door_3x3.redsim.json < examples/circuits/door_3x3.cli.txt
new size 40 force
note "3x3 flush piston door: power the input block @IN to open (test lever @L on top); clear 32 ticks after the input goes on, solid 17 after it goes off; input-safe (any timing)"
place 8 1 2 sticky_piston facing=up
place 8 2 2 sticky_piston facing=up
set 8 3 2 smooth_stone
set 9 3 2 smooth_stone
place 10 3 2 sticky_piston facing=west
set 6 3 1 stone
set 6 3 3 stone
set 7 3 1 stone

label D21 9 5 2 "door cell (x 2, row 1)"
label D22 9 6 2 "door cell (x 2, row 2)"
# harness: a stone button and an oak button on the input block's sides (the lever is on top)
place 9 2 11 stone_button face=wall facing=east
place 7 2 11 oak_button face=wall facing=west
label SB 9 2 11 "test stone button (20 ticks)"
label OB 7 2 11 "test oak button (30 ticks)"
settle
at 2 use 8 3 11
seek 40
rebase
prefab save door_3x3 0 1 0 16 8 11
group door_3x3 0 1 0 16 8 11 in @IN IN out @D11 C

target new lever "open: side cells clear 8 ticks after the lever, all nine 32 after; close: solid 17 ticks after"
